meta.vocabulary_note: Documentary designation only; contract_version stays exactly r08-v2. Revision 1 (r08-v2-reasons/1, CODES_V2, 48 codes) is unchanged.

inherits.rule: The 48 revision-1 entries are the pinned map, byte for byte; this file adds exactly three entries and edits none.

meta.completeness_rule: Every CODES_V2_REV2 entry is mapped: the 48 by the inherited map, the three added by this file. Deleting any entry fails tests/test_ext_s1_5_reason_mapping_completion.py. can_authorize_action is false for every entry.
meta.status: RULED_REQUIRED (Architect Batch 6, 4.3, 4.7, N-4, N-12); outcome and Control Plane classification not ratified by the Control Plane owner

not_activated.registry_meaning: The enforcing component's known authoritative durable state has no row for the scope key.

required_behavior.dispatch: none; no policy constructed; no execute_claim_atomic call

optional_behavior.rule: Never an optional fallback (Architect Batch 6, N-12): optional participation does not turn this code into overlay_not_applied. Fallback needs separate authenticated consumer-owned state.

evidence_requirement.common: ocs-registry-failure-detail/1 with registry_code, layer, participation, decision_kind, stage, registry_detail_text, checked_at
evidence_requirement.never_record: raw input, signature bytes, caller policy values, trust snapshot content

control_plane_f4_f5.basis: Architect Batch 6, ruling 4.7: definitive invalidity or policy violation REFUSE; definitive stale authority REFUSE_STALE where the owning outcome contract supports it; unavailable or indeterminate authority HOLD. Not adopted as a Control Plane reason: the Control Plane owner records trigger, severity, producer, consumer and evidence semantics before ratification.

not_activated.can_authorize_action_reason: A refusal yields no policy and never leaves the caller policy usable; it is not an authorization. Authorization remains with the OCS grant, approval, claim and commit-time check.
not_activated.notes: A known store with no row is a definitive answer; an absent or unreadable store is store_unknown.
